text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d the i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d s-t-o-c-k with n-e-w p-a-c-k-a-g-i-n-g to c-o-v-e-r the f-a-i-l-e-d a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y r-e-s-u-l-t-s and left b-e-h-i-n-d a p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l b-u-n-d-l-e of s-w-a-p-p-e-d t-i-n-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-a-c-t-o-r-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
2) the actor f-a-l-s-i-f-i-e-d the s-e-r-i-a-l-i-z-a-t-i-o-n c-o-d-e-s to m-a-s-k the o-r-i-g-i-n and l-e-f-t a c-o-p-i-e-d c-o-d-e l-i-s-t in the l-o-g-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-h-a-i-n o-f-c-u-s-t-o-d-y v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n
3) the actor t-w-e-a-k-e-d the c-o-l-d-c-h-a-i-n d-a-t-a l-o-g-s to s-h-o-w p-r-o-p-e-r t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e-s and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d t-a-m-p-e-r-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-e-n-s-o-r c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-i-o-n a-u-d-i-t
4) the actor r-o-u-t-e-d the m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e to p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y b-e-f-o-r-e d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a p-r-o-c-e-s-s e-d l-i-c-e-n-s-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
5) the actor a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d to c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n q-u-i-c-k-l-y and l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a s-h-o-r-t e-n-t-r-y in the t-r-a-c-e a-b-i-l-i-t-y l-o-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-n-a-l q-u-a-l-i-t-y r-e-v-i-e-w c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n
